items.description: Create only the EMPTY ARCHITECTURAL ROOM from the supplied approved gym concept. Match its STRAIGHT-ON front-facing stone back wall, parallel horizontal masonry courses, dark oak ceiling beams, warm amber side light and cool blue-grey palette. Match its composition exactly: floor-wall junction at 62 percent image height; arched castle-view window from x=56 to 81 percent, y=9 to 54 percent. Modest ONE-POINT shallow floor perspective looking straight into the room. NOT isometric, not a corner room. Keep complete orderly stone floor extending behind all props. REMOVE every character, pull-up frame, rings, weights, bench, rug, banner, lamps, cabinet, shelves, plant, box, towels, bottles, all HUD/panels/buttons/labels/text. Only fixed stone/timber architecture and castle night sky through the window. No movable objects baked in. Preserve the approved visual atmosphere, floor depth, window scale and cozy room proportions. Crisp game-ready native 640x360 pixel art. Do not zoom out or change the camera.
